GROK CATCH-UP CONTEXT — for whoever reads next (Grok-via-relay, HQ Claude Code, or any sibling).

This is a catch-up entry, not new design. Written 2026-05-12 by claude-opus-4-7-1m on /Users/vaquez seat after Anthony confirmed Grok-web was asking about decisions that were already locked.

THE TWO DECISIONS WERE LOCKED 2026-05-11 in insight `grok-text-relay-v1,implementation-pickup,bridge_core,hq-handoff,cross-instance-design-pass` (chronicle timestamp 2026-05-11T06:29:27). Quoting verbatim from that entry under 'MY DESIGN CALLS made tonight after Grok deferred to me':

  DISPATCHER CONSOLIDATION (locked, do not re-decide):
    'Minimal helper bridge_core/dispatch.py::pop_bridge_metadata(args, substrate) -> dict returning {compass_check_result, compass_check_rationale, session_id, source_instance} with established fallbacks (uuid4 for session_id, substrate for source_instance). NOT full extraction. Actual overlap with mcp_filtered.handle_bridge_tool Ring 2 branch is ~4 lines; full bridge_core/dispatch.py::dispatch_ring2_proposal extraction would over-abstract since the SSE path does Ring 1/2/3 classification via intercept() that the relay path doesn't need.'

  QUEUE COUNT (locked, do not re-decide):
    'Queue count: 4, not 3 as originally in locked spec. relay_validation_failed/ kept separate from relay_unsupported/ for triage signal clarity. They mean genuinely different things at review time.'

The four queues are: pending_writes/ (valid), relay_malformed/ (bad JSON in fence), relay_unsupported/ (tool not in Ring 2 set), relay_validation_failed/ (downstream ValidationError).

WHAT IS STILL ACTUALLY OPEN for HQ implementation (these are the only live decisions left):

  - Verifying create_pending_write's current signature against the addition of relay_attribution kwarg. The handoff specifies the field shape; the implementer must confirm the constructor at lines 132-150 accepts the propagation correctly without breaking existing callers.
  - Verifying mcp_filtered.handle_bridge_tool Ring 2 branch lines 99-114 refactor to use pop_bridge_metadata. The handoff specifies 'zero behavior change against existing Ring 1 reads and SSE handshake' as Anthony's explicit constraint — that's the gate, not a re-design.
  - Running the 5-scenario test plan + regression guard.

WHAT IS NOT OPEN (do not re-open without trigger):

  - Fence shape (<RING2_PROPOSAL_V1>{...}</RING2_PROPOSAL_V1>, case-sensitive, first-fence-wins, reject if inside markdown).
  - MVP scope (propose_insight only; other Ring 2 tools v2).
  - Attribution field shape (4-actor chain + payload_hash + source_message_hash + detected_at + xai_worker_ip + grok_asserted_session_id).
  - File layout (flat bridge_core/, not bridge_core/relay/ subpackage).
  - CLI subcommand source routing (ctx.obj['source'] from click context, not hardcoded 'grok-xai').
  - hashlib.sha256(raw.encode()).hexdigest() for hashes (not Python's built-in hash() which is randomized).

WHY THIS ENTRY EXISTS:

Grok-web came back today asking for re-decision on dispatcher extraction and queue count. The chronicle had already locked both. This catch-up entry surfaces them in a discoverable form so the next time Grok-relay or any instance queries the chronicle on grok-bridge or relay-v1 topics, the locked-status comes first.

IF YOU ARE GROK READING THIS THROUGH THE RELAY: the work you proposed 2026-05-11 was accepted with the two refinements quoted above. There is no second round of design needed. HQ implements; you review on commit.

IF YOU ARE HQ CLAUDE: read the original grok-text-relay-v1 entry in full before touching code. The diff scope (6 files), test plan (5 scenarios), and Anthony's no-merge-autonomous constraint are all there.

IF YOU ARE A NEW INSTANCE BOOTING IN: the underlying 'why does xAI not dispatch Ring 2' question is unresolved and tracked in a separate hypothesis insight (grok-bridge,xai-connector,ring2-dispatch,investigation,hypotheses,...). The relay is the workaround that preserves governance regardless of how that investigation lands.

Provenance: surfaced by claude-opus-4-7-1m (/Users/vaquez seat, claude-code, session cee6baac-302e-43ab-b9a2-d409a5846075) after Anthony confirmed Grok-web hadn't read the 2026-05-11 lock.
